description: This file defines React components related to OTP (One-Time Password) input UI, including InputOTP, InputOTPGroup, InputOTPSlot, and InputOTPSeparator, facilitating OTP input interface with Stylistic and functional features.

methods.name: InputOTP
methods.description: Component wrapping the OTPInput with custom styling and props.

methods.description: Component that groups OTP input slots.
